notes: Temperatures are no longer read from the computers unless you switch them on in Computers > Monitor settings, after reports of blue screens. A license banner now shows on every page, and after the free month a counter with no key keeps its first three computers. License keys now start with RT1: an older NP1 key no longer works, so ask for a new one. The Client Terminal Setting page has the new launcher themes and how long the Home banner holds each game.
